_about: The package layout. arrows and test_arrows: every import from one goinfer package to another, by repository-relative directory, from non-test and from test files; TestLayout_arrows fails on one the tree makes that is not here, and on one here the tree no longer makes. rules: the protected separations, which no import, made or recorded, may break; they are edited by hand only.

rules.name: fit-leaf
rules.why: decoder/fit (Tier 3, docs/layout.md) holds the fit guard's and the planner's exchange types so a caller can name them without importing the loader. It sits below decoder, which re-exports them: it imports internal/runtime/mem and no other goinfer package, decoder included.

rules.name: resident-leaf
rules.why: decoder/resident holds the contract a resident backend implements (the four subsystem interfaces, the provider, ResidentForward, the drafter host and the small data their signatures carry) so a reader can hold it without the loader (MZ5 option B, docs/sub1-resident-interfaces.md). It sits below decoder, which aliases every name in decoder/residentalias.go: it imports internal/cost and internal/runtime/adapter and no other goinfer package, decoder included.

rules.name: config-leaf
rules.why: decoder/config holds a checkpoint's Config, its validators and its loader, so they test in seconds without compiling decoder. It sits below decoder, which aliases Config: it imports no goinfer package, decoder included.

rules.name: quant-leaf
rules.why: decoder/quant (Tier 3, docs/layout.md) parses safetensors checkpoint quantization configs and reconstructs FP8, GPTQ, AWQ, NVFP4 and MLX quantized weights behind Reconstructor/RowStreamReconstructor. It sits below decoder and imports no goinfer package, decoder included.

rules.name: ggufconfig-leaf
rules.why: internal/runtime/ggufconfig reads a GGUF's metadata into a Config, one reader per architecture, so the readers and their fuzz target test without compiling decoder. It sits below decoder, which calls Read: it imports decoder/config and no other goinfer package, decoder included.

rules.name: rope-leaf
rules.why: internal/runtime/rope holds the rotary embedding kernels (NeoX, interleaved, m-RoPE) and the rope_scaling/rope_parameters parsers with their inverse-frequency tables, so they test without compiling decoder. It sits below decoder, which calls it: it imports no goinfer package (its tests, internal/testpath).

rules.name: testassets-leaf
rules.why: internal/testassets resolves heavy test assets through testdata/assets.json, the one predicate for whether an asset is present. It imports no goinfer package and not testing, so a backend's tests can reach it without importing decoder.

rules.name: normact-leaf
rules.why: internal/runtime/normact holds the CPU forward's row norms and elementwise activations, so they test without compiling decoder. It sits below decoder, which calls it: it imports no goinfer package.

rules.name: giwcodec-leaf
rules.why: internal/runtime/giwcodec implements the .giw binary weight-bundle format (writer, reader, shape validator, island bf16/f32 helpers, row4 emitter, and target policy) below decoder (SZ13c). It never imports decoder.

rules.name: wbuild-leaf
rules.why: internal/runtime/wbuild implements safetensors and GGUF weight building, quantization/row streaming, and .giw streaming sinks below decoder (SZ13b). It never imports decoder.

rules.name: cpuengine-leaf
rules.why: internal/runtime/cpuengine implements the CPU forward pass, KV cache, decode scratch, attention/MLP/recurrent kernels, and matmul dispatch below decoder (SZ15). It never imports decoder.

rules.name: families-leaf
rules.why: internal/runtime/families holds the per-family architecture adapters (arch_*.go, gemma12.go), model_type registry, and safetensors tensor schemas below decoder (SZ13a). It imports only the arch/config/rope/program/ggufconfig leaves and never decoder.

rules.name: arch-leaf
rules.why: decoder/arch holds the resolved Architecture descriptor, Weights, LayerWeights and LoadProfile below decoder (SZ12 option (b)), aliased back from decoder/zz_arch_alias.go. It never imports decoder.

rules.name: archparts-leaf
rules.why: internal/runtime/archparts holds per-family parameter and weight structs and small internal helpers below decoder/arch (SZ12 option (b)). It imports only internal/runtime/hybridattn and internal/runtime/mamba2 and never decoder or decoder/arch.

rules.name: memprice-leaf
rules.why: internal/runtime/memprice holds pure per-backend weight, KV, recurrent-state, scratch, and allocator byte pricing over Architecture, Weights, and program declarations below decoder. It never imports decoder or any backend.

rules.name: kvsnap-leaf
rules.why: internal/runtime/kvsnap manages GPU-to-host prefix KV snapshots, LRU byte budgets (resident.KVHostBudget), candidate matching, and boundary/recurrent cut planning below decoder. It imports only decoder/resident and internal/runtime/kvmgr and never decoder.

rules.name: paging-leaf
rules.why: internal/runtime/paging holds MoE expert paging, the pread expert buffer pool, and dense layer paging below decoder (SZ16). It never imports decoder.

rules.name: blockdraft-leaf
rules.why: internal/runtime/blockdraft holds the DFlash and DSpark block drafters, weight streaming, and resident byte estimators below decoder (SZ16). It never imports decoder.

rules.name: residency-leaf
rules.why: internal/runtime/residency holds resident subsystem resolution, KV scope, the resident decode batcher, slot reuse/sharing, host snapshot orchestration, and recurrent checkpoints below decoder (SZ16). It never imports decoder.

rules.name: sidecar-leaf
rules.why: internal/runtime/sidecar holds .giw sidecar transcoding, GGUF metadata extraction, projected and LoRA sidecars, and readback helpers below decoder (SZ16). It never imports decoder.

rules.name: specdecode-leaf
rules.why: internal/runtime/specdecode holds speculative decoding drafters, trace collection, adaptive depth, optimistic-forward overlap, and verification loops below decoder (SZ16). It never imports decoder.

rules.name: towers-standalone
rules.why: The towers moved from aikit (AX) as model semantics over aikit's kernels: no goinfer package, and from outside the standard library only aikit's linalg and embed. One exception: internal/audio may import internal/vision, whose tower program type the audio towers walk (Francis, 2026-10-29). A second: internal/vision may import internal/vision/imgproc, its own standard-library-only image math leaf, which this rule also covers (maintainer decision, 2026-11-27: the resize, normalization and patch math split out of the tower package without opening it to any other goinfer import).

rules.name: gpudev-standalone
rules.why: The device substrate (AX) sits under every backend package and imports none of them, nor anything else of goinfer's.

rules.name: kernels-free-of-decoder
rules.why: Backend kernel tests left the packages that import decoder (SB1 step 1) so a decoder edit stops re-running them.

rules.name: probe-standalone
rules.why: The one reader of the OS's memory account (MM0) imports no goinfer package; that it is the only reader is TestOnlyProbeReadsOSMemory.

rules.name: root-free-of-backends
rules.why: The root module builds without a GPU toolchain or binding: the backends are their own modules, which import the root, never the reverse.

rules.name: scheduler-standard-library
rules.why: The scheduling policy (SB6) is decisions over plain values: no goinfer package and nothing outside the standard library, so it can be tested on a virtual clock with nothing loaded.

rules.name: engine-below-the-shell
rules.why: The engine package (SB7) is what the serving shell asks of a model; the shell imports it and its fakes, never the reverse, so a fake engine needs no server.

rules.name: serveapp-fakes-test-only
rules.why: The engine fakes are test code: the serving shell's production files do not link them. A test supplies its engine through loadedModel.fakeEngine.

rules.name: serveapp-stores-leaf
rules.why: internal/app/serveapp/stores holds the bounded in-memory serving stores (FileStore, BatchStore, GenerationRegistry, FeatureCache, ResponseStore) below serveapp (SA1). It imports only internal/app/serveapp/jobs and internal/batchio and never decoder or serveapp.

rules.name: serveapp-streamframe-leaf
rules.why: internal/app/serveapp/streamframe holds SSE transport, thinking-block splitting, reasoning-token budget resolution, /v1/responses reasoning items, and Responses/Anthropic stream state machines below serveapp (SA2). It never imports decoder or serveapp.

rules.name: serveapp-media-leaf
rules.why: internal/app/serveapp/media decodes inline base64 images and audio clips, rewrites conversation media history, and parses /v1/embeddings media items below serveapp (SA3). It imports only embeddinggemma2 and never decoder or serveapp.

rules.name: serveapp-towerfit-leaf
rules.why: internal/app/serveapp/towerfit prices vision towers, routes vision and audio towers across CPU and GPU backends, checks WebGPU unified-memory fit, recovers or falls back on device OOM, and swaps Gemma 4's tower against the expert cache below serveapp (SA3).

rules.name: serveapp-embedders-leaf
rules.why: internal/app/serveapp/embedders adapts causal decoders into serialized last-token-pooling embedders and resolves EmbeddingGemma 2 device placement below serveapp (SA3). It never imports serveapp.

rules.name: serveapp-adminsock-leaf
rules.why: internal/app/serveapp/adminsock provides the 0600 Unix-domain /admin/* socket listener and CLI subcommands below serveapp (SA4). It imports no goinfer package.

rules.name: serveapp-netguard-leaf
rules.why: internal/app/serveapp/netguard provides loopback DNS-rebinding and browser cross-origin guards, constant-time API-key auth, request body caps, in-flight admission, and JSON error framing below serveapp (SA4). It imports no goinfer package.

rules.name: serveapp-banner-leaf
rules.why: internal/app/serveapp/banner formats startup status lines for loaded generative models, KV pools, concurrency settings, and server route summaries from resolved Facts below serveapp (SA5). It never imports serveapp.

rules.name: serveapp-towers-leaf
rules.why: internal/app/serveapp/towers holds per-family vision and audio tower implementations, device placement fallbacks, and multi-image block splicing and span assembly below serveapp (SA6). It never imports serveapp or decoder.

rules.name: serveapp-wirecore-leaf
rules.why: internal/app/serveapp/wirecore holds shared wire-format types, message-to-turn translation, stop and UTF-8 streaming holdback, context-overflow diagnostics, KV-boundary discovery, and tool-choice / grammar wiring below serveapp (SA7). It never imports serveapp or decoder.

rules.name: serveapp-anthropicapi-leaf
rules.why: internal/app/serveapp/anthropicapi holds Anthropic /v1/messages and /v1/messages/count_tokens request/turn/tool-choice/output-config translation, content-block builders, and SSE frame helpers below serveapp (SA8). It never imports serveapp or decoder.

rules.name: serveapp-responsesapi-leaf
rules.why: internal/app/serveapp/responsesapi holds OpenAI /v1/responses request decoding, input-item and carried-reasoning translation, response-store byte accounting, tool-call item assembly, and response-object formatting below serveapp (SA9). It never imports serveapp or decoder.

rules.name: serveapp-systemone-leaf
rules.why: internal/app/serveapp/systemone holds TypeSafe /v1/systemone and Cloudflare Clef decision request parsing, ordered JSON encoding, and probability response formatting below serveapp (SA10). It imports only internal/clef and internal/decide.

rules.name: serveapp-batchapi-leaf
rules.why: internal/app/serveapp/batchapi holds OpenAI /v1/files, /v1/batches, and Anthropic /v1/messages/batches input parsing, line validation, bounded worker-pool dispatch, and result formatting below serveapp (SA10). It never imports serveapp or decoder.

rules.name: gatecore-leaf
rules.why: internal/guard/gatecore holds the go test -json event accumulator, matrix cell runner, run-record codec, /proc memory sampler, git/pre-move path helpers, and pure tally/skip/timeout graders below cmd/gate (GT1). Its production files import only internal/runtime/mem/probe.

rules.name: gatehygiene-leaf
rules.why: internal/guard/gatehygiene holds the repository, diff, and baseline-ledger gates (changelog, comments-only, ledger, mutation, shadow) below cmd/gate (GT2). It imports only internal/guard/gatecore and internal/guard/paritykey (its tests, internal/testpath).

rules.name: gateidentity-leaf
rules.why: internal/guard/gateidentity holds gate identity's cross-revision worktree builder, logit dumper, .giw byte/logit transcode comparator, asset planner, and pure identity graders below cmd/gate (GT4), isolating cmd/gate's sole tokenizer dependency.

rules.name: gatequick-leaf
rules.why: internal/guard/gatequick holds gate quick's package dependency graph, changed-file-to-cell selector, parallel cell runner, duration/summary records, and pure quick graders below cmd/gate (GT3). It imports only internal/guard/gatecore, internal/guard/gatehygiene, and internal/guard/paritykey (its tests, internal/testgate and internal/testpath).

rules.name: gaterelease-leaf
rules.why: internal/guard/gaterelease holds gate release's pre-flight runner, gpu-records, GPU/parity record codecs and qualification graders, and accepted-reds reader below cmd/gate (GT5). It imports only internal/guard/gatecore, internal/guard/gatehygiene, internal/guard/gatequick, and internal/guard/paritykey (its tests, internal/testpath).

rules.name: chatcore-leaf
rules.why: internal/chat/chatcore holds shared conversation structs, segment builders, history rules, order-preserving JSON helpers, and JSON Schema parameter typing below chat and its dialect leaves (CH1). It imports only tokenizer and the standard library.

rules.name: chat-harmony-leaf
rules.why: internal/chat/harmony holds gpt-oss Harmony prompt rendering, TypeScript namespace tool declarations, channel-message stream splitting, and recipient tool-call extraction below chat (CH2). It imports only internal/chat/chatcore and the standard library.

rules.name: chat-gemma4tools-leaf
rules.why: internal/chat/gemma4tools holds Gemma 4's non-JSON tool-calling micro-language renderers, O(N) control-marker sanitizer, schema formatter, and call parser below chat (CH3). It imports only internal/chat/chatcore and the standard library.

rules.name: chat-inkling2-leaf
rules.why: internal/chat/inkling2 holds Inkling 2's <|message_*|>/<|content_*|> prompt and tool rendering, reasoning effort levels, reply stream splitter, and tool-call parser below chat (CH3). It imports only internal/chat/chatcore and the standard library.

rules.name: chat-toolwire-leaf
rules.why: internal/chat/toolwire holds ChatML/Hermes, Qwen3.5 XML, Mistral, Llama-3, and Flint tool prompt renderers and parsers, schema-validated trailing fenced JSON call extraction, and ProseStreamer/StreamableLen below chat (CH4). It imports only internal/chat/chatcore and the standard library.

rules.name: chat-reasoning-leaf
rules.why: internal/chat/reasoning holds checkpoint thinking-mode detection, ThinkSplitter, UTF-8 rune-safe ReplySplitter, and token-level reasoning/call budgets below chat (CH5). It imports only internal/chat/chatcore, tokenizer, and the standard library.

rules.name: vlprep-leaf
rules.why: internal/runtime/vlprep holds multimodal sequence preparation below decoder: placeholder span validation, raw-feature splicing, resident block/claim conversion, window/DeepStack/m-RoPE readiness guards, Gemma 4 row builders, CPU multimodal prefill walkers, and prefill KV upload (VL1-VL3). It never imports decoder.

rules.name: moecache-leaf
rules.why: internal/runtime/moecache holds host-side MoE expert slot LRU residency, provisional admission rollback, stage demand accounting, and expert-major (row, rank) batch grouping shared across GPU backends (GPU1). It imports no goinfer package.

rules.name: batchplan-leaf
rules.why: internal/runtime/batchplan holds multi-sequence ragged sequence ordering, consecutive-slot row validation, post-RoPE query temperature scaling, and step-width piece slicing shared across GPU backends (GPU2). It imports only decoder/resident and the standard library.

rules.name: vision-imgproc-leaf
rules.why: internal/vision/imgproc holds the pure image math under internal/vision: bilinear resize with normalization, torchvision's antialiased bicubic and bilinear resizes, aspect-ratio-preserving target sizes, and patch unfolding. It imports no goinfer package and nothing outside the standard library.

rules.name: giwkv-leaf
rules.why: internal/runtime/giwkv implements the .giw-kv session snapshot format below decoder: CPU KV cache and token encode, header and CRC reading, and the geometry, allocation-ceiling and payload-length guards on decode. It imports only internal/runtime/cpuengine, internal/runtime/giwcodec and the standard library, never decoder.

rules.name: webgpu-wgsl-leaf
rules.why: backend/webgpu/internal/wgsl holds the pure WGSL compute shader source strings for the WebGPU backend (WGK2). It is cgo-free and imports no goinfer package.

rules.name: webgpu-towers-leaf
rules.why: backend/webgpu/internal/towers holds the standalone WebGPU vision tower accelerators below backend/webgpu (WGK1). It never imports backend/webgpu or decoder.

rules.name: cuda-towers-leaf
rules.why: backend/cuda/internal/towers holds the standalone CUDA vision and audio tower accelerators below backend/cuda (GTW2). It never imports backend/cuda or decoder.

rules.name: metal-towers-leaf
rules.why: backend/metal/internal/towers holds the standalone Metal vision, audio and embeddinggemma2 tower accelerators below backend/metal (GTW1). It never imports backend/metal or decoder.

rules.name: loraload-leaf
rules.why: internal/runtime/loraload reads PEFT LoRA adapters below decoder: adapter_config.json rank and scale, safetensors lora_A/lora_B pairing, target and shape validation, the in-place f32 merge, and per-layer compute-time delta indexing. It never imports decoder.
